name: Early Pearl
summary: **Early Pearl** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds|Sensi Seeds]] in the Netherlands, first released in the mid-1980s as a cross of [[early-girl|Early Girl]] and [[pollyanna|Pollyanna]], a Colombian-Mexican sativa hybrid. It was developed for cooler climates and short summers, flowering outdoors in 7 to 10 weeks.
